alt: 圖書館裡，衣著整齊的年輕人微微欠身，和氣地遞上書本，並以端莊有禮的姿態為長者指引座位。
scene_prompt: 文質彬彬 means refined, cultured and courteous in manner, not mere fashionable clothes. Modern public library welcome desk, a neatly dressed young adult man with a simple collared shirt and cardigan stands gracefully with an upright relaxed posture, a small warm smile, and gently inclines his head as he offers a carefully held book to an elderly visitor. One hand supports the bottom of the closed book, the other indicates an available reading chair with an open polite palm. Elderly visitor smiles gratefully. His calm attentive expression and considerate unhurried gestures convey cultured courtesy and dignified manner. Shelves of unlettered books, simple indoor plant and soft daylight establish a thoughtful setting. No bowtie or top hat stereotype, no exaggerated bow or servility, no medals, no glasses necessary. Two people only, exactly two arms and legs each, fingers correct, book supported and not floating, natural chair and desk structure. No titles or readable lettering on books, no speech bubbles or words.
